proxyManager.title: Proxy IPs
proxyManager.desc: Manage SOCKS and Xray-backed egress nodes for accounts and test outbound connectivity to DeepSeek.
proxyManager.modalDesc: Supports SOCKS5, Shadowsocks (ss://), VLESS, VMess, and Hysteria2 account egress.
proxyManager.passwordKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the currently stored password.
proxyManager.nodeUriKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the currently stored node URI.
proxyManager.typeHelp: socks5 resolves the target hostname locally before dialing through the proxy; socks5h forwards the hostname to the proxy for remote DNS resolution.
proxyManager.coreTypeHelp: The node URI is treated as sensitive and is not returned by safe admin APIs. Shadowsocks uses an ss:// URI. One shared Xray process exposes a private local SOCKS listener for each active node.
proxyManager.requiredFields: Host and port, or a node URI, are required.
proxyManager.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete proxy {name}? This cannot be undone.

proxyManager.deleteConfirmRouted: Permanently delete proxy {name}? {count} assigned account(s) will move: manual routes go to the fallback node, automatic routes are reassigned to tested healthy nodes and signed in again. The deletion is rejected if no safe destination exists. This cannot be undone.

proxyManager.coreAutoDetect: Auto-detecting xray next to the app or from PATH
proxyManager.coreAutoDownload: Automatically download Xray when it is missing
proxyManager.policyDesc: Schedule tests, disable failed nodes, and select a fallback route.
proxyManager.subscriptionsDesc: Import and periodically update Shadowsocks (ss://), VLESS, VMess, and Hysteria2 nodes.

settings.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 4 characters.
settings.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Please sign in again.
settings.safetyPolicyDesc: Apply blocklists, banned content, and jailbreak policy to JSON protocol requests, then record blocked hits in history.
settings.jailbreakEnabledDesc: Use built-in phrases plus custom phrases below.
settings.blockedIpsPlaceholder: One IP or CIDR per line, e.g. 203.0.113.10 or 203.0.113.0/24
settings.allowedIpsPlaceholder: One IP or CIDR per line; allowlisted IPs are exempt from auto-ban escalation
settings.autoBanEnabledDesc: When the same IP triggers content / regex / jailbreak blocks above the threshold within the window, append it to the IP blocklist automatically.
settings.llmCheckEnabledDesc: When enabled, every chat / responses / messages request is first sent to deepseek-v4-flash-nothinking for a binary verdict (violation / ok); violations get a hard 403 block. Replaces the v1.0.13 substring catalogue, dramatically reducing false positives.
settings.llmCheckFailOpenDesc: Whether to let traffic through when the audit LLM times out / errors. Disable for stricter posture (rejects all on error, may drop legitimate traffic).
settings.llmCheckMaxInputChars: Max input chars to audit (truncated head+tail)
settings.llmCheckHelp: Audit consumes the main account pool's LLM quota; default deepseek-v4-flash-nothinking is recommended. Identical inputs are sha256-cached for 10 min by default.
settings.jailbreakPatternsPlaceholder: One extra jailbreak phrase per line
settings.safetyPolicyHelp: File uploads and binary streams are not scanned. Regex rules are validated on save.
settings.accountHealthCheckHint: Checks one eligible account per interval in round-robin order and skips muted, rate-limited, busy, or tokenless accounts. Scheduled checks never log in a tokenless account.
settings.cacheDesc: Tune semantic cache keys, memory cache, disk cache, and compressed response storage.
settings.cacheSemanticKeyDesc: Ignore transient request IDs, tool call IDs, and meaningless whitespace to improve hit rate for Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, and similar clients.
settings.cacheHotReloadHelp: The directory is managed by .env / config files. Other fields hot-reload the response cache instance; memory cache warms up again and disk cache keeps using gzip files.
settings.thinkingInjectionDesc: Append a structured <think> checklist to the latest user message before prompt assembly.
settings.thinkingInjectionPromptHelp: Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt shown as the input placeholder.
settings.proFlashCompressionEnabled: Compress oversized Pro history with Flash
settings.proFlashCompressionDesc: Opt in to one real Flash request to summarize older turns before retrying an oversized Pro request. Disabled by default.
settings.sessionChunkingEnabled: Preserve oversized input with one upstream session
settings.sessionChunkingDesc: Use Flash no-thinking to choose safe boundaries, commit original fragments to one pinned conversation, then answer only after the final fragment. Disabled by default and mutually exclusive with Flash summarization.
settings.summaryCompactionDesc: Use Flash to create a real summary at the context threshold while retaining recent complete turns. Disabled by default; explicit Compact is always honored.
settings.incrementalRotationKeepRecent: Recent turns kept on session rollover
settings.currentInputFileDesc: Enabled by default. Once the character threshold is reached, upload the full context as a DEEPSEEK_WEB_TO_API_HISTORY.txt context file.
settings.currentInputFileHelp: Default is 0, which uses independent split for any non-empty input.
settings.compatibilityDesc: Compatibility controls that keep stream output closer to the wire format or safer for the web UI.
settings.wideInputStrictOutputDesc: Accept looser client input while normalizing responses strictly to the target protocol.
settings.autoDeleteDesc: Choose how DeepSeek remote chat records are cleaned up after each request completes.
settings.autoDeleteNoneDesc: Keep the remote session after the request completes.
settings.autoDeleteSingleDesc: Delete only the remote session created by this request.
settings.autoDeleteAllDesc: Delete every remote session for the account after the request completes.
settings.autoDeleteWarning: This mode deletes remote chat records. Use with caution.
settings.invalidJsonField: {field} is not a valid JSON object.
settings.defaultPasswordWarning: You are using the default admin password "admin". Please change it.
settings.appUpdateDesc: Check releases on the server, verify the published checksum, then switch the persisted application files inside Docker without replacing the image.
settings.appUpdateUnsupported: This runtime can check releases, but in-place application updates require the Docker self-update entrypoint.
settings.appUpdateEndpointUnavailable: The running backend does not expose the self-update API. Restart it with a matching newer server binary.
settings.appUpdateEnabledDesc: The server checks release metadata on this interval.
settings.appUpdateAutoDownloadDesc: Only platform-matched files with a valid SHA-256 checksum are staged.
settings.appUpdateAutoApplyDesc: Applies the verified version and restarts the application process.
settings.appUpdateFailedCandidateDesc: {version} failed before it became ready. Automatic apply is paused for this version; use Apply and restart only after reviewing the release.
settings.appUpdateApplyConfirm: Apply {version} and restart the application process now? Active requests may reconnect.
settings.appUpdateApplyStarted: Update is being applied. The application will restart shortly.
settings.appUpdateRollbackConfirm: Rollback to the previous application version and restart now?
settings.appUpdateRollbackStarted: Rollback is being applied. The application will restart shortly.
